title: Science, Technology & Innovation for Climate Action - COP28 Publication
shortDescription: Flagship advocacy brochure designed to showcase the Joint FAO/IAEA Centre’s nuclear technology solutions during COP28. All photography, vector atomic schematics, and editorial copy were produced independently.
mandateChallenge: Deliver an executive-ready print and digital publication for COP28 delegates that balances scientific rigor with Swiss editorial clarity.
executionCraft: Shot original laboratory photography, designed custom geometric atomic line-art motifs in Illustrator, and executed multi-page editorial layout in InDesign.
impactMetric: Official COP28 Delegation Publication · Zero Errata
